name: DolphinBench routed-v4 fresh FULL 600 with live pass/fail
objective: Execute all 600 DolphinBench tasks once in a fresh run under routed-v4 with qualified transport retries and live AtSys pass/fail counts. Original grading and preserved evidence. No new 20-task pilot. Self-tested, not official.
plan: Owner authorized a new 600-task run from task 1 with timeout retry and explicitly removed the new 20-task pilot. Full-only admission requires fresh routed profile, simulated app/crash and six-scenario local transport receipts bound to the source. One new output, one launch. Reader Luna/high subscription; judge Sol/medium Azure-only OpenRouter; memory and grading fixed; USD20 cap with uncertain calls reserved. Retries are limited by campaign budget and AtSys deadline. No action replay, evidence deletion, fixture edits or real-account access. Hugging Face evidence backup remains private.

successCriteria: 600 unique tasks executed and graded exactly once under the new frozen condition and original scoring.
Independent validator accepts task, source, cost and evidence integrity.
Per-action report and self-tested limitations are recorded.
deliverables: Fresh immutable MEM run evidence and full-result.json
Independent AtSys validator result, outcome record and report
Private Hugging Face evidence batches and per-action breakdown
constraints: No new 20-task pilot; full-only source-bound profile, app/crash and transport qualifications required.
Keep frozen product, memory, routes, models, grading, simulated app isolation and USD20 cap.
No replay of uncertain app actions, no deletion of prior evidence, no invented costs.
assumptions: Owner explicitly waived a new behavioral pilot; this is a self-tested campaign.
stages: Qualify frozen full-only condition with zero model calls
Execute 600 tasks once with transient judge retry
Validate and report all results and costs

observers.rationale: Read saved executions and grades with live passed and failed counts.
Independently validate complete 600 evidence after worker exit.

goalContract.recoveryScope: At most two inspect-only retries and two read-only supervisor calls. No scored relaunch.
escalationConditions: Uncertain action or charge requiring reconciliation
Budget, disk, credential, endpoint or evidence failure
goalContract.budget: USD20 incremental paid API cap. Subscription and supervision charges separate and unknown.
